text:
Trevor: sketching a tiny "resume" protocol for onprem airgapped upgrades. goal: let a verifier-sidecar finish interrupted manifests safely.

Asha: yes please. manual recovery is too frequent right now.

Trevor: minimal contract: ordered components, per-component activate_seq, content hash, and an append-only checkpoint. add a short activation lease to avoid races. sidecar only resumes when lease expired or operator yields.

Jin: signing? we must avoid forged manifests/checkpoints.

Trevor: manifest + checkpoints signed by operator key. support KMS when available; default local keypair for fully airgapped installs.

Maya: observability hooks: emit structured JSON events for manifest.fetch, lease.acquired/expired, apply.component.succeeded/failed, verify.resume.attempt/success/abort. console should show a one-line human summary too.

ops: checkpoint durability question — power loss mid-apply.

Trevor: use append-only WAL with atomic fsync per record and periodic snapshot. keep last-good manifest next to WAL. replayable on boot.

Asha: UI/CLI controls? operator should be able to yield the lease.

Trevor: yes: CLI helpers like show-manifest, show-checkpoint, claim-lease, yield-lease. also a small local RPC: GET /manifest/:id, POST /checkpoint, POST /lease, POST /lease/claim, POST /verify-action.

Jin: components must be idempotent or offer precheck hooks. manifest adds apply_idempotent flag and optional precheck_cmd.

Maya: alerting idea: page on >2 verify.resume.abort on a host in 10m.

Trevor: next steps: I'll draft RFC with manifest schema + proto. PoC: agent checkpoint API + lease manager; console event ingestion. volunteers: Jin=crypto, Maya=events, Asha=UX.

upgrade-bot: recorded: manifest edge-service-v3 submitted by Trevor @1774456789 id=man-20260712-01 status=staged. :white_check_mark:

Asha: sounds good. I'll start UX notes.

Jin: I'll do signing doc.

Maya: will prototype event payloads.
